title: Why Hell buried the Doom Slayer in DOOM
subject: doomslayer
description:
Would you have opened that sarcophagus? 👇

How the UAC dug the Doom Slayer out of Hell and woke him up on Mars. Spoilers for DOOM (2016).

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by id Software or Bethesda Softworks. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Hell couldn't kill him, so it locked him in a stone tomb.
Years later, the UAC dug that sarcophagus out of Hell and hauled it to their research base on Mars.
Then demons overran the base, and the Doom Slayer woke up chained to a slab.
Ancient texts called the Slayer Testaments had described him long before. One line says his soul was tainted beyond ascension.
When Samuel Hayden appeared on a monitor to explain the situation, the Slayer shoved the screen aside.
Mars had dug up the one thing Hell was afraid of.
